remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Also exhibited as 291 Gal. in 1917" [was not in exhibition]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Painted 1916. See gallery photograph 10–a" [1923 exhibition]. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive date 1916. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1917. Dated 1917 on basis of similarities of cat. no 188. "33" on verso of mount in Downtown Gallery inventory number Abiquiú Notebooks indicates no. 31 in 1958 exhibition; Downtown Gallery Archive indicates no. 33 in 1958 exhibition. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 21. See cat. no. 176. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Nude No. III

description: Vertical watercolor of seated female nude on cream background.  Seated with legs hanging down one opens to the right.  Left and right arm at side of body and chest. Face, arm and right leg and torso fall into shadow.  Legs are lighter, as  source of light.  Nude No. III. Possibly Self-Portraits etc. as noted in #176.
